title: data/reading.json
description: Four reading figures summarised from books.json, so the homepage can show them without downloading the whole shelf. Written weekly by .github/scripts/refresh_books.py (summarise) alongside books.json.

books.description: Distinct books on the read shelf. The homepage shows it rounded down to the ten, with a plus.

reviews.description: Books with a written review (v in books.json). The homepage shows it as is.

thisYear.description: Finishes dated in the current calendar year, counting every session: a re-read this year counts again.

rereads.description: Earlier finishes on file across the shelf: the total length of every p in books.json.

updated.description: Date of the refresh that wrote the file, YYYY-MM-DD, in the runner's clock (UTC in CI).
